sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA professional with **4.8 years of manual QA experience**, including **gaming applications** for online and mobile platforms. Built and executed test cases, analysed product requirements, and reported defects across payment, gaming, and retail domains. Strong analytical skills and a record of collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve testing processes.
